name: Chronal Anchor
lore: Holds your own clock steady. Carry it into fields where time runs fast or slow.

name: Chronon Capacitor
lore: Holds quanta of time. Handle before use.
research: Chronodynamics - If time is quantised, its quanta can be stored.

name: Feynman Diagram
lore: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.
research: Quantum Field Theory - Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

name: Formal Proof Tree
lore: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.
research: Formal Logic - Axioms, inference rules, proofs. Unlocks the Formal Proof Assistant and the Empty Set.

name: Godel Sentence
lore: "This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.
research: Incompleteness - Any system strong enough to describe arithmetic contains truths it can never prove - reality included.

name: Source Code Fragment
lore: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments.
research: The Simulation Hypothesis - If reality is computed, it can be decompiled - and edited.

name: Primordial Charter
lore: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.

name: Quantum Codex
lore: The Theoretical Sciences field guide.

name: Attoscale Inductor
lore: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.
research: Assembly Lines - Attoscale components and the Femtoscale Assembly Line - the only way to build high-tier processors.

name: Dipole Winding
lore: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle coil. Its field bends a particle beam into a ring.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: Femtoscale Inductor
lore: A superconducting coil wound around nothing.
research: Femtoengineering - Components smaller than a proton, soldered with superconductors. Unlocks the Femto Fabricator and the Qubit Processor.

name: Superconducting Coil
lore: Zero resistance. The current never stops.
research: Cryogenics - Near absolute zero, matter forgets it is many particles. Superfluids and Bose-Einstein condensates.

name: Annihilation Core
lore: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.
research: Annihilation Power - Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.

name: Antimatter Pellet
lore: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything.
research: Antimatter Containment - Pair production and Penning traps.

name: Coherence Stabiliser
lore: Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam - or in an altered vacuum.

name: Genome Sample
lore: Every instruction for building one creature, in a vial.

name: Noble Gas Clathrate
lore: Xenon caged in ice. The noble gases are not as aloof as the textbooks said.
research: Supramolecular Chemistry - Molecules that build themselves into cages, frameworks and machines. Unlocks MOFs, clathrates and self-healing polymers.

name: Stem Cell Culture
lore: Cells that have not yet decided what to become.
research: Synthetic Biology - Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

name: Tardigrade Culture
lore: Survives vacuum, radiation and freezing by simply pausing being alive.
research: Extremophiles - Life at the edges: boiling vents, frozen vacuum, radiation. Unlocks tardigrade cultures.

name: Xenogenome Sample
lore: A genome from a creature of another dimension. Its code is not written in DNA.

name: Aleph-Null Shard
lore: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.
research: Transfinite Mathematics - Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

name: Bekenstein Crystal
lore: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.
research: The Holographic Principle - Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

name: Cherenkov Boule
lore: A single crystal of Cherenkov quartz, grown in superfluid helium. Ready to be sliced.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Cherenkov Quartz
lore: Glows with the blue light of particles outrunning light in a medium.
research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

name: Chiral Crystal
lore: Left-handed or right-handed, never both. Life only uses one hand.
research: Quantum Chemistry - Solve the Schrödinger equation for a molecule and you have its chemistry. Unlocks orbital lattices and chiral crystals.

name: Dilithium Crystal
lore: Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.

name: Electride Crystal
lore: A salt whose negative ions are bare electrons sitting in holes in the lattice.
research: Electrochemistry - Chemistry is electrons moving; push them with a voltage. Unlocks the Electrolytic Cell.

name: Exotic Matter Crystal
lore: Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.
research: Cosmogenesis - False vacuum decay plus inflation equals a new universe. Then harvest it.

name: Folded Protein Crystal
lore: A chain of amino acids that found its one shape out of more than the universe has atoms.
research: Protein Folding - A chain finds its one shape among astronomically many. Unlocks folded protein crystals.

name: Fractal Core
lore: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.

name: Frozen Photon
lore: Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.
research: Inside a Black Hole - What is past the horizon - and, through an Einstein-Rosen bridge, what is past the white hole's. Unlocks the Horizon Diver and the Geodesic Anchor.

name: Graviton Crystal
lore: Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Hyperdimensional Boule
lore: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension.
research: Hyperdimensional Geometry - Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

name: Hyperon Crystal
lore: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be.
research: Accelerator Physics - Bend a beam with dipoles, focus it with quadrupoles, push it with RF cavities - and keep it all at two kelvin in a perfect vacuum. Unlocks the beamline components and the Hyperion Synchrotron.

name: Lattice Seed Crystal
lore: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.
research: Precision Lithography - Grow crystal boules, slice them into wafers, engrave them through lenses and cut them into dies. Unlocks the Lattice Growth Vat, Planck-Scale Cutter and Quantum Lithographer.

name: Crystallised Law
lore: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.
research: Hyperdimensional Reality - The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

name: Moduli Crystal
lore: The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.

name: Psionic Crystal
lore: Resonates with thought.
research: Psionics - Thought, crystallised. A science that should not exist.

name: Pulsar Timing Crystal
lore: Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.
research: Compact Stars - Neutron stars, magnetars, pulsars and quark stars - the densest objects short of a singularity.

name: Quantum Chlorophyll
lore: Photosynthesis moves energy by trying every path at once - coherently.
research: Quantum Biology - Photosynthesis, enzymes and migrating birds all use quantum coherence. Unlocks quantum chlorophyll and magnetoreceptors.

name: Retrocausal Crystal
lore: It formed after you mined it.

name: Scintillator Crystal
lore: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: Superposition Crystal
lore: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Topological Boule
lore: A boule doped with topological insulator. Its surface conducts; its interior never will.
research: Topological Matter - Phases of matter protected by topology rather than symmetry.

name: Graviton Harness
lore: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields.

name: Inertia Damper
lore: Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.
research: Mass Manipulation - Massless matter, negative mass and the inertial dampers every starship needs.

name: Bottom & Top Quarks
lore: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.
research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

name: Fractal Dust
lore: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.
research: The Platonic Realm - If mathematical objects exist somewhere, they exist here. Unlocks the Platonic Compass.

name: Quantum Dot
lore: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.
research: The Casimir Effect - Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

name: Strange & Charm Quarks
lore: The second generation: heavier, and they only exist for an instant outside strange matter.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Turing Morphogen
lore: Two chemicals, one fast and one slow, that paint stripes and spots by themselves.
research: Morphogenesis - How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

name: Up & Down Quarks
lore: The two lightest quark flavours - everything you have ever touched is made of them.
research: The Quantum Foam - Below the Planck length spacetime is a boiling foam where particles borrow existence from the vacuum. Unlocks the Planck Diver and the Vacuum Fluctuation Harvester.

name: Hawking Emitter
lore: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.
research: Singularity Physics - Event horizons, Hawking radiation and the Kugelblitz: a black hole made from light alone.

name: Tachyon Klystron
lore: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future.
research: High-Energy Particle Physics - Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

name: Dilaton Crystal
lore: A frozen value of the string coupling - how strongly strings interact. Grows on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk.

name: Higgs Boson Crystal
lore: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.
research: The Standard Model - Six quarks, six leptons, four gauge bosons and the Higgs. Unlocks the Particle Spectrometer.

name: Lorentz Transform Crystal
lore: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.
research: Special Relativity - The speed of light is the same for everyone - so time and space cannot be. Unlocks the Tensor Calculus Engine.

name: Novikov Crystal
lore: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.
research: Temporal Mechanics - The arrow of time, and how to tie it in knots without causing a paradox. Unlocks the Chrono Loom.
